cats.title: AI Systems & Agent Engineering
cats.label: Type 01
cats.lede: The system that builds systems. Anyone can hold a tool. This is the method that makes tools work together, which is the line between an AI architect and someone who only uses AI.

cats.title: Commerce Operations
cats.label: Type 02
cats.lede: The work a seller does every day and the work that eats the most hours: pulling numbers, checking them, building reports, watching rivals, listing, and protecting the brand.

cats.title: AI Search Visibility (GEO)
cats.label: Type 03
cats.lede: Getting a brand found and cited inside ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and Perplexity. The newest direction, and the one the fewest people can do.

cats.title: Content Production Line
cats.label: Type 04
cats.lede: The full chain from angle to publish, where every stage has its own standard and handoff. Not writing 1 piece of copy, but a production line that actually runs.
